context: Stage 3 (D3): staleness probes fixed — compound-scope splitting, git-mv basename fallback, capped scores with noisy-or; plus twining_unarchive, archive_stale batch warning, and archived_excluded_count in assemble/why
rationale: max() means independent signals can never corroborate, so capping every heuristic below threshold would have made staleness_review return nothing; noisy-or lets scope 0.8 + files + branch 0.4 legitimately cross 0.95 while no single heuristic reaches certainty
summary: Chose noisy-or aggregation over keeping max() with lowered caps
